headline: I Cannot Picture Life Without My Caregiver. She's Better Than Family.

carousel.title: I Cannot Picture Life Without My Caregiver. She's Better Than Family.
Phyliss Filderman
before: Phyliss cared for her husband alone, and letting anyone else in felt impossible.
10 years · Rarely left the house except for the doctor
after: The team cared for her husband and, she says, looked after her too.
Always covered · A substitute every time

carousel.title: She was carrying her husband's care alone.
carousel.text: Letting MCM in was, in her words, "very strange for me," but the team eased that, even caring for her while the men cared for her husband at night.

carousel.title: Every caregiver earned her trust.
carousel.text: "All of the people were more than qualified and everyone that helped my husband, I would recommend individually, that's how competent they were."

carousel.title: The relationship outlasted her husband.
carousel.text: When he died two years ago, Phyliss refused to lose the caregiver she'd come to love.

carousel.title: They stayed close after the loss.
carousel.text: "When I lost my husband, they came to the funeral cemetery.

Having this nurse from Medical Consultants has been like my mother giving birth to my sister, although she takes better care and is more loving than my sister. I could not picture my life without her. She's better than family at times, so I consider her my family.
carousel.by: Phyliss Filderman · Philadelphia · became a client herself after her husband's passing
